retained_diagnostic_history: The first clean-suite attempt lacked Git on PATH. Reusing the existing Git tools resolved that environment failure; the subsequent complete suite passed.
An overbroad packaging exclusion also removed an authored wrist flange. Exclusions were narrowed to vendor STL/URDF files; the final regression and archive/relocation checks passed.
One build exhausted system temporary storage. Only its verified task-owned temporary wheel was moved; the final build used a dedicated data-volume temporary directory.
limitations: A clean public checkout cannot run native evaluation until the exact complete AR5-08 bundle is supplied. Downloading the inspected official repository alone is insufficient.
The native renderer also requires the exact converted arm visual layers. A raw vendor URDF/mesh archive alone is not the prepared benchmark bundle.
Links and local import tooling do not establish missing redistribution permissions.
The native evaluator remains ROKAE AR5-08 with Wuji Hand 1 and PhysX. Additional models are not newly qualified for the 66 tasks.
Task/controller integration and the original render-manifest hashes are retained. No new GPU run or all-task success claim is made for this distribution change.
Earlier complete-installation evidence is preserved in robot-assets.json and does not certify out-of-box availability in the current public package.
